hero_eyebrow: Professional Painter & Decorator — Quality Finishes Every Time
hero_subhead: Tired of tired walls? A M Coatings delivers flawless interior and exterior painting across Southampton, with meticulous prep and finishes that last.
services_subhead: From fresh interior walls to weatherproof exterior finishes, we handle every type of painting and decorating project with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh your rooms with expertly applied emulsion, satin, or specialist finishes. We prep, prime, and paint to leave your home looking showroom-ready.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Protect and brighten your home's exterior with high-quality exterior paint and sealants. Weather-resistant finishes that stand up to Southampton's climate.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Colours
services.desc: Make a statement with bold colours or textured finishes. Expert colour consultation and precision application for impact that lasts.

services.title: Woodwork & Trim Painting
services.desc: Doors, skirting, cornicing, and window frames finished to a high gloss or satin sheen. Meticulous preparation ensures smooth, durable results.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Expert wallpapering with precise pattern matching and seamless finishes. We also carefully remove old wallpaper without damaging your walls.

services.title: Commercial & Residential Redecorating
services.desc: Full-scale redecorating projects for homes and small commercial spaces. We work around your schedule, with minimal disruption and professional clean-up.

about_pullquote: We measure twice, paint once, and take pride in every brushstroke.
about_para_1: A M Coatings was founded on the belief that quality decorating shouldn't mean months of chaos or hidden costs. With over 15 years of hands-on experience, we've built a reputation for meticulous preparation, attention to detail, and finishes that look better than the brochure. Whether it's a single feature wall or a whole-house redecoration, we treat every project with the same care and precision.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we keep our promises: we arrive on time, we prep properly, and we leave your home spotless. We listen to what you want and deliver exactly that — no upselling, no compromise on quality. Based right here in Southampton, we know the local properties, the weather challenges, and the neighbourhoods we serve.

reviews.text: Had A M Coatings in to do our lounge and hallway. They were tidy, professional, and finished bang on schedule. The prep work was thorough — the walls look immaculate. Would absolutely have them back.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our exterior. House needed a refresh after a few years of weather. They sorted everything from woodwork to render, and the colour really lifts the property. Fair price too, nothing hidden.
reviews.author: Caroline H.

reviews.text: Called for a quick quote on redecorating three bedrooms. Got back to me same day, showed up on time, and the work was finished two days later. Tidy lads. Will use again without question.
reviews.author: David P.
